registrations.name: ROT10
registrations.rule: Monthly at month-end close, execute next open: universe = top-200 by 63d avg dollar-volume, price>=20, 12-1 momentum (c[-21]/c[-252]-1) capped <=200%; hold top-10 equal-weight. DANGER/CRISIS: freeze (hold, no rotation). No stops.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d return in >=55% of windows over >=126 trading days AND MDD <= 1.5x XLK MDD in the window
registrations.kill: -20pp cumulative vs XLK at any point
registrations.context_at_registration: registered 19 days into a momentum crash; backtest OOS +17.8pp vs QQQ (tier B, in-sample-searched); live first-19d: -13.7pp vs QQQ

registrations.name: MOMBRK5
registrations.rule: Daily: Minervini gate (px 10-200, > SMA50/150/200 stacked, within 5% of 252d high, low>252d low+30%, ret20>5%, daychg<10%, ret5<=15%), rank by 126d return, top-5, enter next open, Fixed90d exit. Only in HEALTHY/PULLBACK/DIP_BUY regimes.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK on rolling 42d in >=55% of windows over >=126 td

registrations.name: MRDIP
registrations.rule: MR strict gate (RSI2<10, >SMA50, ATR 3-15%, buf>=5%, vol>=1x, RSI14<60, px>=10), composite-ranked top-5, next-open entry, Fixed42d exit. Deploy ONLY in DIP_BUY/SHARP_DROP/BEAR_BOUNCE. Earnings<=7d veto.
registrations.promotion: positive mean edge vs XLK across its deployment windows, >=20 closed positions
registrations.kill: mean edge < -2pp per deployment after 20 positions

registrations.name: V4BLEND
registrations.rule: 50% core (XLK) + 50% ROT10, monthly rebalance to weights; MRDIP overlay funded from core (max 2x10%); DANGER/CRISIS = no new buys, no rotation.
registrations.promotion: beats XLK cumulative at >=126 td with MDD <= 1.3x XLK
